confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel rates are lower because July peak-season pricing varies widely. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor (about 2x and about 1.1x) because direct local knowledge is thinner. FX is from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page for 13 Oct 2026, not a direct table read; an unverified 14 Oct figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against similarly priced Southeast European capitals such as Sofia and Bucharest, with accommodation rates adjusted upward for July tourist demand.
